script_text: Cancer, this week the cosmos flips your love life and your paycheck in the same breath. Monday, Mars in your 1st House sextiles Venus in your 5th House, so you glow; say yes to that date. Tuesday, your ruler the Moon enters Libra, your 4th House, and sextiles Jupiter in your 2nd House: a home or family offer arrives with money attached. Wednesday is the turning point: the Sun leaves your romantic 5th and enters Sagittarius, your 6th House of work, turning fun into payroll. Saturday, Mercury trines Saturn in your 10th House; deals close, promotions land. Sunday, Pluto stirring your 8th House, slows into Venus-in-Scorpio intimacy. Saturday is your power day because Mercury trines Saturn in your 10th. Wednesday is the fuzziest because the Sun changes signs. Tip: put every deal in writing before Saturday. Follow for daily updates, Cancer; trust your Water intuition.
